title: Ionis Ranked #1 Top Employer by Science
summary: Ionis has been recognized as Science’s #1 Top Employer for 2026. In only our second year of eligibility, this honor highlights our industry-leading innovation, talented employees and strong values-based culture.
body_markdown:
We are excited to be recognized as Science’s #1 Top Employer for 2026. In only our second year of eligibility, this honor highlights our[industry-leading innovation](https://ionis.com/science-and-innovation) , talented employees and strong[values-based culture](https://ionis.com/about-us/our-culture) .


Hear from some of our talented employees and one of our executives about what makes Ionis a special place to do their best work and pursue medical breakthroughs that have the potential to improve people’s lives.


Does this sound like a place where you could grow your career? Learn more about our award-winning workplace at[ionis.com/careers](https://ionis.com/careers) .


Science and Science Careers’ 2026 Top Employers Survey findings reflect approximately 5,100 responses from readers of Science and other invitees. Respondents to the web-based survey were asked to rate companies based on 24 characteristics.


For more information about this recognition, read our[press release](https://ir.ionis.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ionis-ranked-1-sciences-top-employers-list) .
